messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the current time, you could check a reliable world clock or your device’s clock set to the Eastern Time Zone.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we cannot provide real-time. But maybe we can use a function? There's no function for time. We can respond with a note that we can't fetch real-time. We can provide approximate based on UTC offset. But better to say we don't have real-time. So answer: "I don't have real-time capability."
